client_id.description: Google OAuth 2.0 client ID for the refresh-token grant. Used only in the token-request form; never logged.

client_secret.description: Google OAuth 2.0 client secret (optional for some client types). Used only in the token-request form; never logged.

refresh_token.description: Long-lived Google OAuth 2.0 refresh token. Exchanged for a short-lived access token at token_url; never logged. The 3-legged consent/acquisition dance is out of scope for this connector (credentials layer already owns it).

base_url.description: YouTube Reporting API base URL override for tests or proxies. Reporting streams and job write actions use this host.

token_url.description: Google OAuth 2.0 token endpoint override. MUST be https in production; the hook fails closed on a non-https or unparseable value to prevent exfiltrating the refresh token/client secret to an attacker-chosen endpoint.

scopes.description: OAuth scope requested on the token-refresh grant. Use a caller-controlled value only when the selected Google account and operation require a different documented YouTube Analytics/Reporting scope.

content_owner_id.description: Optional content-owner ID; sent as the onBehalfOfContentOwner query parameter for content-owner-scoped read streams. Declarative write actions omit this optional query parameter until write-action query templates are supported.

job_id.description: Reporting job ID. Required when reading the reports stream, the single job stream, or the single report stream.

report_id.description: Reporting report ID. Required when reading the single report stream.

include_system_managed.description: Optional includeSystemManaged value for Reporting jobs and report types.

created_after.description: Optional Reporting reports.list createdAfter filter, expressed as an RFC3339/Google datetime string.

start_time_at_or_after.description: Optional Reporting reports.list startTimeAtOrAfter filter, expressed as an RFC3339/Google datetime string.

start_time_before.description: Optional Reporting reports.list startTimeBefore filter, expressed as an RFC3339/Google datetime string.

page_size.description: Records per page (1-100 for Reporting list operations).

max_pages.description: Maximum pages; use 0, all, or unlimited to exhaust the stream.

mode.description: Runtime mode: live (default) or fixture for credential-free conformance.
